analysis.description: This living room features a modern design with a focus on clean lines and contemporary aesthetics. The focal point is a polished marble panel serving as a wall, complemented by a dark brown wooden accent wall with vertical paneling. A built-in media console with a glossy white finish provides storage and integrates seamlessly into the design. The space is illuminated with ambient lighting, highlighting the textures and polished surfaces. While not distinctly Indian, the use of marble and wooden accents suggests a nod to traditional Indian materials and craftsmanship.

metadata.indian_specific: Minimalistic use of traditional materials and styles
